design: Historical bounds shell + existing archived owner reconstruct original complete JS; old fold and analysis imports remain the oracle. Separate current graph loader verifies fixed source/JS/declaration pins for the full three-module closure then imports ordinary src/dist modules. No arbitrary digest options, old-output substitution or source fallback. Current validation runs before imports even for cached namespaces.

checks.overlap: Twenty-one identical named groups ran in both modes; five unchanged direct-display groups ran source-only. Three loader groups are new. These are group counts; old inner golden observations and synthetic executor invocations are reused, not additional unique tests.
checks.negativeArtifacts: Missing and corrupted emitted files for each of fold/bounds/analysis reject current caller loading; valid old bounds JS also rejects the current pin. Controlled read ports return same missing-error identity. Historical bytes remain independently reconstructible; current module namespace identity matches ordinary actual source/dist imports.

redProof.correction: Original digest assertion remains exact; its input now comes from explicit historical bytes. Current consumers verify and import new artifacts separately.

expression.method: Read local initial snapshot; reverse only @knorvia/contracts and @knorvia/dynamic-workflow package-scope strings to @zcode equivalents. Bind resulting bytes with both Git blob SHA1 and recorded LF SHA256. No publisher fetch, commit-tree verification, new copyright assertion or MIT conclusion. AST function/comment comparison respects template syntax; raw hashes are evidence of expression retention, not rights proof.

fold.decision: Mixed retained expression. The complete foldPairs function (72-87) is byte-exact to recorded pinned reference content; quotient/SCC have new structures, but a whole-file independent-expression finding is not supported.
fold.compatibility: RawEdge/public projection import, reducer wire kinds/carryOf fields, ordered key format and first-seen/output constraints are fixed APIs or compatibility facts; standard map/set/field idioms alone do not establish provenance.
fold.retainedProse: Exact reference comments remain at header 1-6, browser-import explanation 11-12, RawEdge comment 15, public explanatory block 22-38, quotient explanation 47-48 and pair-helper explanation 71.
fold.retainedBody: foldPairs retains self-loop admission, first-key ordering, shallow copies, repeated-pair conjunction and ordered map projection. Key construction and reducer field/projection expressions also remain within new quotient control.
fold.newStructure: Iterative two-pass SCC adjacency/DFS/rank representation and quotient edge bindings with ordered candidate admission/selection, documented in preserved specs and commits. Different digests or algorithms alone do not confer rights.

bounds.decision: Mixed retained expression against local initial snapshot; exact publisher comparison remains unavailable. Source exposure is not a permanent bar, but the fresh retention/storage owner does not determine this whole file.
bounds.compatibility: Wire types/field shapes, caps, closure/order/error requirements and fixed public strings/imports are compatibility facts; conventional map/set/literal idioms are disclosed.
bounds.retainedProse: Local-initial header/public lead-in 1-13 and 42-51; helper explanations 225-227 and 234-240. No claim that unmatched reconstructed bytes are publisher content.
bounds.retainedBody: Primary-lane/step closure at 63-78, sink and phase classification/quota/alongside/exits at 123-175, lane/step field projection at 178-213 and clipping/pattern helpers at 228-256 retain substantive procedure/expressions. boundGraphText is text-identical to initial snapshot; boundNamePattern retains its parsed expression with formatting differences.
bounds.newStructure: One call-local frame, counted card admission, full over-capacity projection with capped retained card/handoff arrays, and final payload composition; original runtime prose and helper attribution retained.

expression.candidateReview: Keep both whole files mixed/source-exposed and existing attribution/obligations in place pending root independent expression and contributor-rights review. Neither changed hashes nor passing tests are an MIT grant; root owns actual licence status.
expression.smallestNextDecision: Acquire/verify exact bounds publisher content and independently validate fold publisher commit-tree membership, then assess retained helper/body/prose rights versus ordinary glue and contribution chain. Root may retain applicable licensing or choose a specifically justified separation; no new production rewrite is performed merely for a metric.

limits: No production/public-declaration change or emission; actual existing emitted artifacts are pinned. No broad suite/build/root gate or native Windows/macOS/UI acceptance.

Original archived bytes, hashes, gold assertions, SCC numeric-prototype red proofs and old receipts stay unchanged. Only the historical fixture loader wiring changes; its observation/consumer tail and every assert call remain exact.

Historical SCC executor gold remains unchanged and includes its synchronous synthetic-producer handler(...).then failure in non-early paths. Successful completion/cancellation evidence comes separately from the preserved bounds implementation async-producer tests; no historical snapshot was silently repaired.
No provider/network/model/user files or live workflow effects, runtime/Host/shared-licensing/dependency/CI/security/settings changes, cross-lane edit, merge/release/deploy or publication claim.
reproduce: Use existing Node24.14.0/TS6.0.2 and scoped noEmit script /tmp/knorvia-graph-loader-types.mjs; six recorded fixture/test roots with actual core tsconfig, rootDir undefined. No source generation.
